name: Cold Brew Coffee
siboNotes: Black cold brew coffee is well-tolerated and may actually support digestive health due to its prebiotic properties and lower acidity than hot coffee.
preparationTips: Drink black or with lactose-free milk to maintain low FODMAP status
Avoid adding honey, agave, or high FODMAP sweeteners
Cold brew is naturally less acidic than hot coffee, making it gentler on sensitive stomachs
Store concentrate in refrigerator for up to 2 weeks
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants and chlorogenic acids
Contains beneficial compounds that support liver health
Lower in acid compounds compared to hot-brewed coffee
